name: DJ BeeBot
notes: Hopscotch Labs' city companion that sends a few short updates a day about people, places and events nearby; the requester says it is text-message only for now, aimed at recommendations, neighborhood news and group chats. Requested via the form (issue #160).
tagline: Your social audio guide to the city

access.price: Free; text-message beta via an invite link, iOS app on the App Store
